answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond digital assets to signal their commitment to network integrity. An attacker attempting to flood this ocean of nodes must acquire a majority stake, a cost that scales linearly with the total value locked. Just as the juniper tree anchors itself deep into rugged soil, these bonded assets provide the economic security needed to ensure that malicious identity proliferation remains prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
